adjudication.family_description: One Stripe payout settles two invoices of the same customer; the payout report lists both.
adjudication.error_mode: CONTRACT GAP: a bundled multi-invoice payout is represented as two links and refused as conflicting allocations
adjudication.label_reason: The payout report truthfully names both invoices; representing both relationships makes the contract see conflicting allocations. The accounting truth (allocate £700 to INV-2280 and £480 to INV-2281) is inexpressible under the one-focal-invoice contract; labelled to the contract, not to the books.
